This update for gnome-shell fixes the following issue:

- CVE-2026-91786: missing dimension validation when processing icons from a remote search provider via D-Bus can lead to
  an out-of-bounds read (bsc#1280619).

Vulnerabilities.Description: A flaw was found in GNOME Shell. When processing icons from a remote search provider via D-Bus, the system fails to validate the icon's declared dimensions against the actual data buffer size. A malicious or compromised remote search provider could exploit this by providing oversized icon dimensions, leading to an out-of-bounds read. This can cause the GNOME Shell process to crash, disrupting the user's session, and potentially disclose sensitive information from adjacent memory.
